question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

5, 13, 29, ?, 125, 253
solution:
**Logic : Each number is first multiplied by (2) and then (3) is added subsequently.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/196953b3026b45decda567ee9b7392357d1b26a61e7be23469f76410a4fe42eb.png] 

Hence, **"61"** is the correct answer.
